title: Likelihood-Based Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in CMS Dijet Events
abstract: arXiv:2609.06686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present an unsupervised search for anomalous dijet events in proton--proton collision data using neural spline flow density estimation. A normalizing flow model is trained on a high-dimensional feature space comprising jet, dijet, and event-level observables to learn the dominant Standard Model background directly from data, without assuming a specific signal hypothesis. Events assigned low likelihood under the learned density are identified as potential anomalous events.   Using this approach on a CMS Open Data dijet sample, we investigate extreme events in the tail of the anomaly-score distribution and perform an extensive validation and robustness study. This study includes feature-level statistical comparisons, mass decorrelation tests, permutation-based null tests, and evaluations of training stability. The selected anomalous events exhibit notable departures from the background-only expectation, primarily in jet-substructure o

translated_title: 基于似然的CMS双喷注事件无监督异常检测
translated_abstract: 我们利用神经样条流密度估计，在质子-质子对撞数据中对异常双喷注事件进行无监督搜索。归一化流模型在包含喷注、双喷注和事件级可观测量特征的高维特征空间上进行训练，直接从数据中学习占主导地位的标准模型背景，而无需假设特定的信号假说。在所学密度下被赋予低似然的事件被识别为潜在的异常事件。在CMS开放数据的双喷注样本上使用该方法，我们研究了异常分数分布尾部的极端事件，并进行了广泛的验证与鲁棒性研究。该研究包括特征级统计比较、质量退相关测试、基于置换的零假设检验以及训练稳定性评估。所选出的异常事件表现出对仅背景预期的显著偏离，主要体现在喷注子结构上。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于神经样条归一化流的无监督异常检测方法，直接从CMS双喷注开放数据中学习标准模型背景而无需信号假设，并通过多重验证发现所选异常事件在喷注子结构上显著偏离纯背景预期。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a likelihood-based unsupervised anomaly detection of CMS dijet events using neural spline normalizing flows to learn the Standard Model background directly from data without signal hypotheses, identifying anomalous events that significantly deviate from background expectations in jet substructure.
